The following actions are running on Node.js 20 and may not work as expected: actions/cache@v4, actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-go@v5, actions/setup-java@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4, android-actions/setup-android@v3. Once Node.js 24 becomes the default, you can temporarily opt out by setting ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION=true.
